trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned. Follow the roadmap: finish the story first (and protect the one missable meditation in Chapter 1), then work through 100% completion, then the stranger strands and cleanup. Every trophy is offline, one playthrough is enough, and there are no difficulty-related trophies. Expect around 200 hours in total.
steps: Play the story, Chapters 1 to 5, and keep manual saves (there is no mission replay).
Meditate on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1 — the only missable step.
Reach 100% completion through Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Finish the stranger strands and any remaining trophies; the platinum pops last.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission, Gone Fishing, where the story begins. It unlocks automatically as you play through the mission and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1 of the story. It unlocks automatically when the chapter ends. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation at Jason's house for Positive Mental Attitude — that is the run's only missable step.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 of the story. It unlocks automatically when the chapter ends and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3 of the story. It unlocks automatically when the chapter ends and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 of the story. It unlocks automatically when the chapter ends and cannot be missed. The eight large bank vaults unlock during this chapter, through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is…

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story. It unlocks automatically at the end of Chapter 5 and cannot be missed. Free roam continues after the credits, so every remaining trophy can still be earned.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion, tracked in game under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. You do not need every collectible — only the checklist numbers: the story, 100 optional tasks, 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vaults, fencing targets ($100k narcotics, $100k jewelry, $250k marked bills, $200k vehicles), 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 of 125 Cocaine Flamingos, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, 100 of 255 animals studied, 30 of 40 races won, all 42 shooting-range gold medals, all 42 drone time trials, 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges and all 15 of Bret's target decks. This is the longest trophy in the list and the hardest; leave the 8 bank vaults until the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… unlocks them.
steps: Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story and work down the checklist.
Clear robberies and fencing first — they fund garages and gear for the rest.
Use the WAiNK app and binoculars from the start so vehicles and animals are mostly done.
Stop each activity at its checklist number; the game does not need every item.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts of any kind: stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps. PowerPyx counts 397 stunt opportunities across Leonida, and 100% completion needs 300, so keep going past 250. Stunts register as you travel — use fast vehicles and aim for ramps, bridges and high ledges whenever you see them.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types at least once — racing, the shooting range, fishing, arcade games, pool, mini golf, basketball, drone races and meditation. One attempt at each is enough; you do not need to win. The map's activity icons show what is left.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each range runs several weapon challenges, and gold needs a high score inside the par time. Use the range's practice rounds to learn the target order, and use the weapon each challenge is built around. All 42 gold medals are also required for 100% completion, so this is not skippable on the road to the platinum.
steps: Visit every shooting range and clear its challenges one weapon at a time.
Practice a challenge before going for gold — target order matters more than speed.
Track the gold count in the trophy menu; 42 of 42 pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations. Each location also hosts 3 drone time trials — 42 in total, all required for 100% — so clear the trials while you are there. Fly each course once to learn its gates before racing for the win.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. The count is per course, not per win, so 20 unique courses. 100% completion needs 30 of 40 races won, so this trophy comes naturally on the way to the platinum — keep racing past 20.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot, accept his challenge and outscore his catch inside the time limit. Use the best bait for the spot's fish and watch the tension meter so the line never snaps.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game. Pick the shortest cabinet game and play it through to its ending. 100% completion asks you to play all 4 video games, so try each cabinet while you are at the arcade.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's strand is a Strangers & Freaks questline — follow his missions in order until the finale, Puff Puff Pass. It can be finished after the story, so nothing here is missable.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's strand also ties into his treasure sets — 5 of 7 sets are needed for 100% completion — so hunt his treasures while you work through his missions, then finish the strand to its last mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's strand is one of the stranger questlines across Leonida; follow it from its first mission to its finale. It can be finished after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only some side questlines count toward the 8, and PowerPyx was still confirming exactly which strands qualify as of 19 November 2026 — so finish every stranger strand you find and watch the count in the trophy menu. All strands can be completed after the story.
steps: Clear the five named character strands first: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone.
Then take every other stranger strand you find on the map.
Check the trophy's progress counter after each strand to see which ones counted.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's strand is a Strangers & Freaks questline; follow it from its first mission to its finale. It can be finished after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand is a Strangers & Freaks questline; follow it from its first mission to its finale. It can be finished after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. THIS IS THE ONLY MISSABLE TROPHY: one spot is the balcony at Jason's house, and it is only available in Chapter 1. After the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning — when she mentions meditating, follow her to the balcony and accept her invitation. Do it before leaving Chapter 1; the other 17 spots stay available in free roam. 100% completion needs 15 of 18, but this trophy needs all 18.
steps: In Chapter 1, after Down to Earth, go to Jason's house in the morning.
Talk to Lucia when she mentions meditating, follow her to the balcony, and meditate.
Make a manual save right after — there is no mission replay.
Meditate at the other 17 spots across Leonida whenever you pass them.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret runs the hunting strand — his Target Deck lists 15 hunting objectives, all 15 needed for 100% completion. Track the unique animal he marks, study it with binoculars first, then take the shot.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 card sets in total and 100% completion needs 15, so you will pass 3 early. Cards are found across Leonida — check shops, hideouts and mission rewards, and trade duplicates where you can.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Open the WAiNK app and scan unfamiliar vehicles, landmarks and locations as you travel — scanning from the start of the game saves hours of cleanup later. The same 100 scans count toward 100% completion.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the open-world objective list — 80 in total, and 100% completion needs 70 of them, so push past 50. Open Progress > Challenges to see which are nearest done and finish the easy ones first.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape. Build 4 stars with your partner in the car — robberies and police chases raise the level fastest — then break line of sight and stay hidden until it clears. Your partner must be with you when it clears; a solo escape does not count.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row while keeping the wanted level alive between them — if it drops to zero, the chain breaks. Plan a route of three close shops, keep your partner with you, and move fast between them.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Driving a new vehicle model counts as a discovery, and WAiNK scans help register them. 100% completion needs 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, so keep discovering past 100.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus in a firefight with at least 5 enemies grouped together, and drop all five before the focus ends. Gang hideouts and police shootouts give the best crowds — let them bunch up before you trigger it.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA: steal a departing passenger aircraft from Vice City International Airport. Wait on the tarmac for a passenger jet preparing to leave, board it and take off. Expect a heavy wanted level — have an escape route planned and do not try it mid-mission.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino military tank and use it in combat. Rhinos are guarded at military sites — grab one, then fire its cannon in a fight to pop the trophy. The wanted level will be heavy, so pick your moment and do not try it mid-mission.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store first, go in quiet, take the jewelry and leave before any alarm or witness spots you. If the alarm trips or anyone sees you, leave and retry — detection fails the attempt.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. The 8 large bank vaults unlock with the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — rob any 5 of them and escape each time. 100% completion needs all 8, so plan to clear every vault.
steps: Reach Chapter 4 and complete the optional mission That's Where The Money Is…
Rob a vault, escape the wanted level, then move to the next.
5 escapes pop the trophy; all 8 are needed for 100% completion.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes around Leonida — block one, crack it open, take the cash and lose the wanted level. Any truck on any route counts.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida and uncover the complete map — 52 areas. Drive, fly and sail into every corner; the map fills in as you go. Check the map for fogged regions and sweep them in free roam after the story.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Each gang runs illegal operations on its own turf — rob one per gang. Gang operations also feed 100% completion, which needs all 39 of them.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact trigger is still being confirmed by the community as of 20 November 2026 — head to a beach bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view. Check the cited guides for the confirmed trigger once players pin it down.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The exact method is still unconfirmed as of 20 November 2026 — the name points to driving a car through a showroom's glass front and escaping. Check the cited guides for the confirmed method once the community verifies it.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley: steal the three key valuables there and escape. Case the alley, grab all three valuables and get out without being caught.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal: maximize the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia. Train both characters' strength to max — gyms and melee workouts raise it. Both characters must reach max for the trophy to pop.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse: perform 500 actions affecting your Criminal Profile. PlayStation tracks a count to 500 — crimes, robberies and other profile-raising acts all add up across the whole playthrough. Check the trophy's progress counter to see how far along you are.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The unlock method is still unconfirmed as of 20 November 2026 — no published guide has verified it yet. The name suggests succeeding on a second attempt at something; check the cited guides for the confirmed method once the community pins it down.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The unlock method is still unconfirmed as of 20 November 2026 — the name points to a strange or hidden event somewhere in Leonida. No published guide has verified it yet; check the cited guides for updates as players confirm it.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by: knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. The precise method is still being confirmed — try a melee swing from a slow-moving car at a pedestrian. Check the cited guides for the confirmed method.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies — fence them through your laundering contacts until $250,000 is clean. The same $250,000 counts toward 100% completion.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Weapons, clothes, cars and food all count toward the total. It adds up naturally over a full playthrough; if you are short near the end, buy ammo and vehicles to close the gap.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages go on sale across Leonida — buy all eight. You will need the cash from robberies and fencing, so save up before shopping for property.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the Scooter Bros app and register 10 different vehicles you find around Leonida. Any 10 vehicles count.
